name: Young Dryad
description: An imperious tree-person leading their forest’s defenses.

abilities.name: Voice of the Forest
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies within range of a target they can attack without moving. On a success, their attacks deal half damage.

abilities.name: Thorny Cage
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to form a cage around a target within Very Close range and Restrain them until they’re freed with a successful Strength Roll. When a creature makes an action roll against the cage, they must mark a Stress.

abilities.name: Momentum
abilities.description: When the Dryad makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.
